description: Scenario / conditions ONLY — the inputs that set up the power solution (companion to docs/requirements.md). Trimmed to only the fields the metric engine actually consumes (plus cloudy_derate, now used). Contains NO derived values: AC power, duty, daily energy, array/battery/inverter sizing are computed per part combination by the engine using data/metrics.json. Every field has value, unit, definition, status (known | assumption | open).

meta.use_case: Cool a shaded desert tent while sleeping during the day, off a DIY solar + LiFePO4 system.
meta.note: Informational/redundant fields (location, humidity, envelope_type, system_constraints, etc.) were removed — they weren't consumed by any formula. Chemistry/no-weld/waveform are enforced as constraints in data/configs.json; bus voltage & architecture come from each config.

peak_sun_hours.definition: Equivalent full-sun hours; design around the worst usable value. Feeds array sizing.

outside_temp_day.definition: Design daytime high (~38-43 degC); the temperature the AC works against. Feeds thermal load.

occupancy_count.definition: Number of occupants (x occupancy_gain in the thermal load).

envelope_ua.definition: CONSERVATIVE (high) heat-transfer coefficient of the leaky shaded tent (conduction + infiltration). Deliberately over-estimates the load; calibrate DOWN from a measured AC duty/power. Load = envelope_ua x (outside_temp_day - target_indoor_temp) + gains.

solar_gain.definition: Conservative residual solar heat gain through the shade.

occupancy_gain.definition: Conservative heat added per occupant x occupancy_count (sensible + latent).

cooling_hours.definition: Hours the AC runs per day (feeds AC daily energy).

non_ac_loads.definition: Itemized non-AC loads; the daily total is derived (sum of watts x hours), not stored.

cloudy_day_bridge.definition: Days of overcast operation the battery must carry. On each bridge day the array still delivers cloudy_derate of normal, so the battery supplies design_daily_energy x (1 - cloudy_derate) per day. The main lever on battery size.

battery_buffer_runtime.definition: AC-only runtime the buffer must cover (surge + passing clouds + shoulders of solar noon), on top of the cloudy-day bridge.

cloudy_derate.definition: Fraction of normal daily solar yield on a heavily overcast day; reduces the battery draw during the cloudy-day bridge.

usable_depth_of_discharge.definition: LiFePO4 daily DoD used to convert usable Wh to nominal battery kWh.
